tool_schemas.name: get_citeas_data
tool_schemas.description: Looks up the given resource identifier (for example a DOI, URL, or free-text key) against the CiteAs provider and returns the provider’s BibTeX citation string for the best match. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `resource` is missing or blank, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the service, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded citation retrieval limits. Raises NOT_FOUND when CiteAs returns no resolvable match for the resource, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the provider cannot be reached or returns an invalid response.

tool_schemas.name: get_scholar_data
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Google Scholar search for the given `query` and returns up to `results` BibTeX citation strings for matching publications (the list is limited by `results` and is not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing or blank, if `results` is not a positive integer, or if `results` exceeds the maximum allowed by the service; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use the service. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exceeded Scholar retrieval limits, NOT_FOUND when the query yields no publications with retrievable BibTeX, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Scholar cannot be reached, blocks the request, or returns an unparsable response.

tool_schemas.name: list_citation_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists citation lookup requests visible to the caller, optionally filtered by provider, status, cache key, and time range. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted, and VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid filters or pagination.

client_id.description: Filter by owning client_id (only allowed for callers with cross-client visibility).

created_after.description: Return requests created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Return requests created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_citation_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single citation request by id, including its current status and cache metadata. Returns NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted.

include_citations.description: When true, also returns citations produced by the request (if any).

tool_schemas.name: create_citation_request
tool_schemas.description: Creates a citation lookup request without immediately running an upstream fetch. Use this to enqueue work or to create requests that will be fulfilled by provider attempts. Returns the created request. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when the payload is invalid (including missing required fields or invalid provider-specific fields), and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted.

provider.description: Upstream provider to use for this request.

resource.description: Resource identifier for CiteAs lookups. Required when provider='citeas' and must be omitted for provider='scholar'.

query.description: Scholar query string. Required when provider='scholar' and must be omitted for provider='citeas'.

results_requested.description: Number of results requested for Scholar lookups. Optional for provider='scholar' (defaults to 2). Must be omitted for provider='citeas'.

cache_key.description: Optional cache key override. When omitted, the service computes a normalized cache key from provider+resource/query+results_requested.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_citation_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running citation request. Transitions status to cancelled and prevents new provider attempts from being created. Returns the updated request. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when the request does not exist or is not visible, CONFLICT when the request is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled), and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to record.

tool_schemas.name: create_provider_attempt
tool_schemas.description: Creates a provider retrieval attempt for an existing citation request and records the upstream fetch outcome (including BibTeX extraction). Creating an attempt increments attempt_no (max 10) and will transition the parent request from queued to running if needed. On success, stores/links the normalized publication record and creates citations rows for extracted BibTeX. Refuses with QUOTA_EXCEEDED when starting a new attempt would exceed the caller’s daily/monthly limits (cached responses do not count), CONFLICT if the request is terminal or attempt_no would exceed 10, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid payloads, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted.

http_status.description: HTTP status returned by the upstream provider (if applicable).

latency_ms.description: End-to-end latency for the provider call in milliseconds.

raw_response.description: Provider raw response payload (stored for debugging/auditing; may be truncated by the service).

parse_status.description: BibTeX parsing outcome for this attempt.

citations.description: BibTeX citations extracted from this attempt. For citeas, provide exactly one item with result_rank=1. For scholar, provide contiguous ranks starting at 1 up to results_requested.

result_rank.description: Rank of this result within the request (1-based).

provider.description: Provider for this citation row (must match the parent request provider).

publication.description: Normalized publication fields to insert or match. If doi matches an existing normalized DOI, the service links to the existing publication instead of inserting a duplicate.

source_provider.description: Provider that produced the normalized record.

metadata.name: CiteAssist MCP
